description: We are a team of passionate and curious innovators interested in space science, technology, and problem-solving. We believe in turning creative ideas into practical solutions using innovation, collaboration, and technology. We welcome enthusiastic individuals with skills in programming, electronics, data analysis, research, and design who are excited to explore challenges and create solutions that make an impact.
summary: Mission Cosmathon is an astronaut health monitoring system designed to support the health and well-being of astronauts during space missions. Our project introduces a simple digital dashboard that displays important health parameters such as heart rate, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), and body temperature. It allows users to view current health readings, track changes over time, and identify unusual readings through alerts. The system collects health readings from wearable sensors or sample data, processes them, and presents the information in an easy-to-understand format. It also helps organize health information for astronauts and mission medical teams, supporting early awareness and timely decisions. Our goal is to make astronaut health monitoring more accessible, organized, and efficient, contributing to safer and more reliable space missions.
